description: This file provides functions for reading and writing IEEE 754 floating point numbers from/to byte buffers, supporting various byte orders and sizes. It is a utility module implementing low-level binary data manipulation.

methods.name: read(buffer, offset, isLE, mLen, nBytes)
methods.description: Reads an IEEE 754 floating point number from a buffer, given offset, endianness, mantissa length, and byte size.

methods.name: write(buffer, value, offset, isLE, mLen, nBytes)
methods.description: Writes an IEEE 754 floating point number into a buffer, given buffer, value, offset, endianness, mantissa length, and byte size.

ctags.name: write
ctags.pattern: /^exports.write = function (buffer, value, offset, isLE, mLen, nBytes) {$/
